derivation:
by
  simpa [Set.pi, Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.prod_univ_succ] using
    (MeasureTheory.volume_pi_pi (![{0}, {0}, Set.univ] : Fin 3 → Set ℝ))
explanation: Vec3 abbreviates Fin 3 → ℝ. Instantiate the product-volume formula with coordinate sets {0}, {0}, and univ; simplification gives the axis and zero volume.
